summary: Your family law page offers a free case evaluation, but the buttons that lead to it do not work and the form appears incomplete.

findings.problem: Every Click now to make an enquiry or get a free case evaluation button links to #.
findings.cost: The free evaluation is your main offer, and a button that does nothing loses the client.
findings.fix: Every button linked to a working enquiry form.

findings.problem: The form shows Preferred Office and Type of Enquiry but no name, email or phone field. The listed email uses primelaw.com.au, a different domain from the site.
findings.cost: A client cannot complete the form, and mixed domains look unsure.
findings.fix: A complete form and one brand email.

findings.problem: Only one testimonial is shown (from Phil), no lawyers are named, and the Knowledge Centre link uses a ?page_id=891 address.
findings.cost: Clients want to know who will act for them and hear from others.
findings.fix: Lawyer profiles, more testimonials and clean links.

findings.problem: Copy errors include making it a prime location for clients can easily access and he duration (missing first letter). The payment option is named three ways and the menu repeats.
findings.cost: Errors on a legal page lower trust.
findings.fix: Proofread copy and a single payment option name.

redesign: A complete enquiry form behind every button, with click to call.
Lawyer profiles, multiple testimonials and proofread, consistent copy.
